title: Harden: status history, per-stage attribution, and role separation
objective: Close the three enforcement gaps exposed by the FJ-002 dogfood run: (1) status transitions are prose-only, so implementing -> complete skips verifying/review undetectably; (2) lastVerification can be recorded from a pre-flip run that emitted no terminal rows; (3) one worker performs every stage with no per-stage attribution, so role expertise and review independence cannot be checked. Approved as the full hardening package by the repository owner; execution is sequenced after the phase-0 ladder.
specReferences: gauntlet design §6.2 (semantic include-set freeze; design revision required for new semantic fields)
acceptance: design revision committed first, covering: status transition history, per-stage attribution on stage artifacts, an qa-author != coder-author rule, the workflow norm change ending single-worker multi-role coverage, and resolution of the design's dangling non-semantic `reviews` field mention (forbidden by the schema)
schemas updated to match the revision, preserving additionalProperties rules (work-item gains statusHistory if introduced; stage-artifact gains author if introduced)

verify-candidate enforces: (a) lastVerification coverage — a complete item's recorded report must contain pass rows for every required stage's chain and terminal checks, so FJ-002's pre-flip report-20260926T075318Z would fail; (b) transition order as defined by the revision; (c) qa author != coder author
selftest covers each new check with a fail-closed demonstration scenario
grandfathering defined for items completed before the revision (FJ-001, FJ-002, FJ-043, FJ-048, FJ-PRD-001 carry no history or attribution) so the battery stays green
starts only after FJ-003 and FJ-004 are complete and the in-flight selftest reformat has landed
nonGoals: no soft self-attested markers (assignedRole nudges, lease handoff theater) offered as a substitute for attribution — explicitly rejected by the owner
no engine or gate changes while FJ-003/FJ-004 are in flight
nextAction: R2 verification run at complete, then close commit staging .agent/work/FJ-052 and .agent/reports/FJ-052 only
notes: Decision provenance: FJ-002 dogfood session — owner chose the full hardening package (statusHistory, attribution, role separation, workflow norm change) with execution after the phase-0 ladder; soft markers were rejected as theater.
Absorbs FJ-050 bullets 3 (attribution) and 9 (lastVerification ordering) as execution scope; those bullets remain as findings records.

QA adjudication (orchestrator, R1-precursor): qa.md findings 1-7 accepted as non-blocking. Finding 1 (author row suppressed on unparseable header) fails closed via stage.<s>.header; empty-author and missing-artifact cases cannot reach a pass. Findings 2/4 correct the review brief, not the code. Findings 3/5/6/7 sanctioned by design §8.6/§7/§13 and heredoc-isolation pattern.
